summary: Learn job evaluation, market pricing and salary-range design through practical compensation exercises. Explore the five-day course.
lede: Compensation strategy and design helps reward, HR and finance professionals build and explain consistent pay structures. The course addresses evaluating roles, matching jobs to salary survey data, setting pay ranges, and reviewing pay equity and incentive decisions. Participants practise compa-ratio calculations, market-pricing rationales, and documenting recommendations for leadership through case exercises and spreadsheet work.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who evaluate roles, prepare pay recommendations, administer salary ranges or advise leaders on compensation decisions.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working knowledge of HR processes, job descriptions or salary administration is recommended. No programming is required. Familiarity with spreadsheet calculations will help with market-pricing and pay-range exercises.
